messages.text: To run the real-app check for the round-1 fix: start the backend through the real createApp and POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses (expect 201), POST /api/diagnoses/:id/complete, POST /api/companies/:id/archive and POST /api/companies/:id/restore with Content-Type application/json and body {} (expect no 415). Run tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts and questionnaire.spec.ts once they exist, or add a tests/api case. Also confirm that a 422 incomplete response from the server carries pendingBlocks next to code/message so ApiError.details exposes them.
